description: Defines interfaces and classes for managing the list of QUIC streams that are write blocked, including static and non-static streams, with priority handling and batch write support.

classes.name: QuicWriteBlockedListInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing a list of write-blocked QUIC streams with methods for registration, priority updates, and querying stream states.

classes.name: QuicWriteBlockedList
classes.description: Default implementation of QuicWriteBlockedListInterface, managing static and non-static streams with priority and batch write support.

classes.name: StaticStreamCollection
classes.description: Manages a collection of static streams, tracking registration and blocked states.

methods.name: HasWriteBlockedDataStreams
methods.description: Checks if there are any write-blocked data streams.

methods.name: NumBlockedSpecialStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of blocked static (special) streams.

methods.name: NumBlockedStreams
methods.description: Returns the total number of blocked streams, including static and non-static.

methods.name: ShouldYield
methods.description: Determines if the stream with given ID should yield based on priority.

methods.name: GetPriorityOfStream
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of a specific stream.

methods.name: PopFront
methods.description: Pops the highest priority stream, with special handling for static streams.

methods.name: RegisterStream
methods.description: Registers a stream with a specified priority, ignoring priority for static streams.

methods.name: UnregisterStream
methods.description: Unregisters a stream, removing it from the list.

methods.name: UpdateStreamPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of a stream, not applicable for static streams.

methods.name: UpdateBytesForStream
methods.description: Updates the byte count for a stream (deprecated feature).

methods.name: AddStream
methods.description: Adds a stream to the list, placing it at the back unless latched for batch writing.

methods.name: IsStreamBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a specific stream is write blocked.
